topic: Tenses – Various exercises: Gerund or Progressive
title: -ing Form: Gerund or Progressive Tense?

explanation.tr:
Bir -ing kelimesi iki farklı görevde olabilir:
• Progressive zaman: be (am/is/are/was/were/been) + V-ing → fiil görevinde, eylem devam ediyor.
  They were swimming. She has been working.
• Gerund: isim görevinde; özne, nesne veya edattan sonra.
  Swimming is fun. I enjoy swimming. She's good at swimming.
Test: -ing'in yerine bir isim (ör. 'football') koyabiliyorsan büyük ihtimalle gerund'dur: I enjoy football ✓ → I enjoy swimming = gerund.
explanation.tk:
-ing sözi iki dürli wezipede bolup biler:
• Progressive zaman: be (am/is/are/was/were/been) + V-ing → işlik wezipesinde, hereket dowam edýär.
  They were swimming. She has been working.
• Gerund: at wezipesinde; eýe, doldurgyç ýa-da sözlemden soň.
  Swimming is fun. I enjoy swimming. She's good at swimming.
Barlag: -ing-iň ýerine at (mysal üçin 'football') goýup bilseň, ol köplenç gerund: I enjoy football ✓ → I enjoy swimming = gerund.
explanation.ru:
Слово на -ing может выполнять две разные роли:
• Progressive (длительное время): be (am/is/are/was/were/been) + V-ing → это глагол, действие в процессе.
  They were swimming. She has been working.
• Gerund: роль существительного; подлежащее, дополнение или после предлога.
  Swimming is fun. I enjoy swimming. She's good at swimming.
Проверка: если на место -ing можно поставить существительное (например, 'football'), скорее всего это герундий: I enjoy football ✓ → I enjoy swimming = герундий.

examples.en: They were swimming in the lake. (progressive)
She has been working all day. (progressive)

examples.tk: Men hytaý dilini öwrenmek bilen gyzyklanýaryn.
Men bu ýyl hytaý dilini öwrenýärin.
examples.ru: В этом году я учу китайский.

topic: Tenses – Various exercises: Negative sentences in English
title: Negative Sentences in Different Tenses

explanation.tr:
Her zamanda olumsuz cümle:
• Simple Present: don't / doesn't + fiil → He doesn't smoke.
• Present Progressive: am not / isn't / aren't + -ing → They aren't listening.
• Simple Past: didn't + fiil → I didn't go.
• Past Progressive: wasn't / weren't + -ing → She wasn't sleeping.
• Present Perfect: haven't / hasn't + V3 → We haven't finished.
• will-future: won't + fiil → It won't rain.
• Modallar: can't, mustn't, shouldn't + fiil
• be: am not / isn't / aren't / wasn't / weren't
explanation.tk:
Her zamanda ýokluk sözlem:
• Simple Present: don't / doesn't + işlik → He doesn't smoke.
• Present Progressive: am not / isn't / aren't + -ing → They aren't listening.
• Simple Past: didn't + işlik → I didn't go.
• Past Progressive: wasn't / weren't + -ing → She wasn't sleeping.
• Present Perfect: haven't / hasn't + V3 → We haven't finished.
• will-future: won't + işlik → It won't rain.
• Modal işlikler: can't, mustn't, shouldn't + işlik
• be: am not / isn't / aren't / wasn't / weren't
explanation.ru:
Отрицание в разных временах:
• Simple Present: don't / doesn't + глагол → He doesn't smoke.
• Present Progressive: am not / isn't / aren't + -ing → They aren't listening.
• Simple Past: didn't + глагол → I didn't go.
• Past Progressive: wasn't / weren't + -ing → She wasn't sleeping.
• Present Perfect: haven't / hasn't + V3 → We haven't finished.
• will-future: won't + глагол → It won't rain.
• Модальные: can't, mustn't, shouldn't + глагол
• be: am not / isn't / aren't / wasn't / weren't

examples.en: I didn't go to the party.

topic: Tenses – Various exercises: Negation of questions
title: Negative Questions

explanation.tr:
Olumsuz sorular şaşkınlık, kızgınlık veya 'evet' cevabı beklendiğini gösterir:
• Don't you like it? (Beğenmedin mi? — şaşkınlık)
• Isn't it beautiful? (Güzel değil mi? — onay bekliyorum)
• Yapı: kısaltılmış olumsuz yardımcı fiil + özne + …
  Don't you…? Doesn't she…? Didn't they…? Isn't he…? Aren't you…? Haven't you…? Won't you…? Can't you…?
• Uzun biçim (daha resmî): Do you not like it?
• Dikkat: 'I' ile: Aren't I…? (amn't yok)
• Cevap gerçeğe göre: "Didn't you go?" – "Yes, I did." (gittim) / "No, I didn't." (gitmedim)
explanation.tk:
Ýokluk soraglar geň galmany, gaharyny ýa-da 'hawa' jogabyna garaşylýandygyny görkezýär:
• Don't you like it? (Saňa ýaramadymy? — geň galmak)
• Isn't it beautiful? (Owadan dälmi? — tassyklama garaşýaryn)
• Gurluşy: gysgaldylan ýokluk kömekçi işlik + eýe + …
  Don't you…? Doesn't she…? Didn't they…? Isn't he…? Aren't you…? Haven't you…? Won't you…? Can't you…?
• Uzyn görnüş (has resmi): Do you not like it?
• Üns beriň: 'I' bilen: Aren't I…? (amn't ýok)
• Jogap hakykata görä: "Didn't you go?" – "Yes, I did." (gitdim) / "No, I didn't." (gitmedim)
explanation.ru:
Отрицательные вопросы выражают удивление, раздражение или ожидание ответа «да»:
• Don't you like it? (Тебе не нравится? — удивление)
• Isn't it beautiful? (Разве не красиво? — жду согласия)
• Схема: сокращённый отрицательный вспомогательный глагол + подлежащее + …
  Don't you…? Doesn't she…? Didn't they…? Isn't he…? Aren't you…? Haven't you…? Won't you…? Can't you…?
• Полная форма (официальнее): Do you not like it?
• Внимание: с 'I': Aren't I…? (amn't нет)
• Отвечаем по факту: "Didn't you go?" – "Yes, I did." (ходил) / "No, I didn't." (не ходил)

examples.en: Didn't you get my message? – No, I didn't.
examples.ru: Ты не получил моё сообщение? – Нет, не получил.
Ты не видишь, что я занят?
